title: commutative-diagram
description: A diagram of objects and morphisms in which every pair of directed paths sharing endpoints composes to the same morphism — an equation between composites drawn as a spatial pattern. The primary language in which categorical definitions and universal properties are stated.

parallel-paths.description: two directed paths of morphisms sharing a common start and end object

commutes.description: all directed paths between the same two objects compose to the same morphism
